svg.title: SPROUT: efficient exploration for coding agents
svg.desc: A task and its verifier go to the search, where SPROUT's analyst and reviewer plan attempts and branches. The search runs in the evaluation or in the RL driver, and queues rollout, grade and review jobs in the Run Store. A worker claims a rollout job and checkpoints every turn. A grade job runs the task's verifier in the kept sandbox or in a new one, and its result goes back to the search for the next attempt. Inside each worker, a claim loop runs one child process per job: mini-swe-agent reaches the model through a gateway and the sandbox through ToolAccess and the Sprout runtime, on podman with btrfs or on Firecracker with AgentENV. The rollouts and their rewards go through the RL driver to Miles. Below, branches grow from saved checkpoints C2 and C4. Each checkpoint pairs the agent context with a disk snapshot of the sandbox at a turn boundary.

g.aria-label: Save progress at every turn. Branch from any checkpoint to explore new paths without starting over.
Claim a job, then execute turns
Kept sandbox or a new one
Verifier feedback for the next attempt
Claim loop + one child process per job
SPROUT: new growth from saved progress
Review the result. Restore a checkpoint. Try a new continuation.
The sandbox's disk at that turn
A turn may contain multiple tool calls.
